Vendored from https://github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4 commit b4e7ae776071ceb1dd35004577a8719481e1d258 (GPL-2.0-or-later).
Directories: src/video_core, src/shader_recompiler, src/common, src/core/libraries/{gnmdriver,videoout}, externals/gcn, externals/sirit, externals/half.
Also: src/core/libraries/kernel/{orbis_error,posix_error,time,process,equeue}.h, equeue.cpp, src/core/libraries/error_codes.h, src/core/platform.h, src/core/libraries/system/{userservice,systemservice}.h.
Also: src/core/libraries/avplayer (without the handle streamer), src/core/libraries/videodec/video_utils.{h,cpp}.
Local changes are marked with "gow3:" comments.
Backported from upstream after b4e7ae7 (2026-10-02), recompiler correctness fixes only:
  233562929 V_INTERP_MOV_F32 P10/P20 selectors (#5087), d96278e1e compute shader floating-point
  mode (#5126), e518a6515 S_SUBB_U32 SCC wrap (#5031), 282e5c792 S_ADDC_U32 SCC carry-out (#5030),
  fb6367d29 32-bit literals in the high dword of 64-bit floats (#5114), 94e217781 V_BFM_B32 (#5185),
  d1cb90dbb ADDC (#5200), dd43d1cac V_CVT_PK_U8_F32 (#5194), ef08b1e1f V_ALIGNBIT/ALIGNBYTE (#5186).

Local integration patches (GPL-2.0-or-later files remain under the upstream license):
  - Versioned guest-memory ABI v2 adds process guest-VM allocation/release callbacks;
    VideoOut flip labels use a guest VA plus a stable host view from the primary runtime.
    This replaces the upstream host-heap label address that PM4 WAIT_REG_MEM/EOP could
    not resolve through the primary runtime's guest address space.
  - Host-runtime ABI v2 forwards ordered Liverpool EOP and completed VideoOut flips to
    the primary runtime's equeue/state owners.
  - Local GoW3 shader, image-alias, depth/stencil, blend, presenter, and synchronization
    changes are marked with `gow3:` in source. See the associated regression tests under
    `tests/` and runtime adapter probes under `scripts/lab/probes/gow3gpu/`.
  - ARM64 SRT lowering replaces the upstream x86-64 JIT for direct, immediate-index
    user-data reads. It resolves those reads through the guest-memory API, records
    unsupported nested/dynamic forms, and bumps pipeline/shader metadata versions. This
    path is intentionally incomplete until nested/dynamic SRT handling is implemented.
  - Fetch-shader code is copied from the guest VA through `Core::Memory::CopySparseMemory`
    into a bounded 16 KiB snapshot. Parsing requires an in-range `S_SETPC_B64` terminator;
    guest VAs are never cast to host pointers.
  - Vulkan instance setup explicitly reports/requires the sparse binding and sparse buffer
    residency features used by `BufferCache`. KosmicKrisp and MoltenVK on the M2 currently
    lack both, so the candidate route fails before claiming GPU draw support.

Build target: native Apple Silicon arm64 macOS, CMake/Ninja, C++23 video core, Vulkan
loader supplied by the selected host driver. An arm64 dylib build is not evidence that
the host Vulkan implementation passes the renderer feature/workload probe.
